issues.issue: Whether state protection in Saint Lucia is adequate, rebutting the presumption that the state can protect.
issues.applicant_position: Police do not take the necessary action, so she would not receive state protection.
issues.respondent_position: Police often ignore complaints and victims withdraw them; the evidence is dated and little has changed.
issues.result_text: Claimant's statements on police were vague and speculative; effective protection is available in Saint Lucia.

issues.issue: Whether the claimants face a personal risk to life or cruel treatment on return to Saint Lucia.
issues.result_text: No personal risk to life or cruel treatment on return; claimants are not Convention refugees.
